I could not fully verify this, so treat the answer below as a best guess rather than a derived result.

**What I established.** Locally, D is cut out by s·h = 0, with h = uv + (1+u²+v²)s. For c > 1 the valuation has ν(u) = t, ν(v) = 1−t, ν(s) = 1 (since h − uv has initial form −uv), and ν(h) = c. Its log discrepancy is A_X(ν) = 1 + c, and A_{(X,D)}(ν) = 0. So ν_{t,c} is a log canonical place of (P³, D) over the origin. That places the parameter space T in the family of lc places, but it does not determine S.

**What I did not establish.** I did not compute S(ν_{t,c}), the associated graded ring B_{t,c}, or the klt condition on Proj B_{t,c}. So I have no derivation of where S fails to be locally closed.

**Heuristic behind the guess.** At t = p/(p+q) the weights on (u,v) are p/(p+q) and q/(p+q). The parameter c is a candidate for a change in the graded structure when ν(h) equals the weight of a low-degree monomial in u and v. Among the monomials of total degree 3 in u and v, u²v and uv² have weights (2p+q)/(p+q) and (p+2q)/(p+q). Both exceed 1 for all coprime p, q, which fits the requirement that the answer be a uniform expression. Other candidates such as u³ or u² would only exceed 1 for some p, q. This selection is a heuristic, not a proof.

ANSWER: {(2p+q)/(p+q), (p+2q)/(p+q)}
